# Draft:York and District Boy Scouts War Memorial

The York & District Boy Scout Association War Memorial is a wooden plaque war memorial located close to the English city of York.
The memorial is located in the pavilion at the Scout Activity Centre in Warthill, however, it was originally housed in York City Scouts' Headquarters on George Street, York.
